title: Is Apple Really a Hardware Company?
sentence: In the first nine months of fiscal 2026, services were a quarter of Apple's sales but kept 76 cents of gross profit per dollar, against about 40 cents for devices: almost 40% of Apple's gross profit.
source: Apple, Q3 fiscal 2026 results, Form 8-K exhibit 99.1 (July 30, 2026), nine months ended June 27, 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000018/a8-kex991q3202606272026.htm
